messages:
Lina Tran: Urgent - autopay failed for Meridian Health (acct-MH2) on INV-2401 ($48,200). Gateway decline = expired_card. Customer states treasury can do a same-day wire. They asked if we can accept a wire and mark invoice paid immediately. Thoughts on workflow and approvals?

Javier Morales: Gateway payload shows expired_card. Normally we generate hosted link, but wire is fine if ops & finance sign-off. Need to confirm beneficiary details + order of operations so we don't double-apply payment when autopay retries.

Priya Nair: Customer sent provisional wire details and says their bank will push today. Their AP contact also asked for netting instructions and whether we can release service once funds are confirmed. They want a payment reference so it clears to their ledger.

Sam O'Leary: Proposal: (1) place invoice on manual-hold to stop autopay retries and dunning; (2) accept wire but only mark as "pending wire" in ledger until funds settle (same-day ACH/wire clears); (3) if wire confirmation received from customer + bank trace, provision service hold release. Finance needs to OK temporary credit or service release policy.

billing-bot: Autopay retries paused. Invoice INV-2401 flagged: hold=awaiting_wire. Dunning suppressed.

Javier Morales: We also need to capture bank admin-proof of wire (SWIFT/trace or remittance with reference). Recommend we use template for wire remittance to reduce reconciliation friction. Template: ```Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.\nBank: First Republic Bank\nAccount: 0123456789\nRouting/SWIFT: FRBKUS6S\nReference: INV-2401 / MH2```. Please confirm with treasury/legal before sharing.

Lina Tran: I approve accepting a customer-initiated wire for this invoice. Conditions: (a) CS must upload bank trace or remittance confirming amount and reference; (b) Finance will mark invoice as "pending wire" but not finalize until funds settle; (c) we can authorize up to $10k temporary credit if they report partial lag and services would be impacted. No permanent credit without VP sign-off.

Priya Nair: Confirmed - customer will send SWIFT trace when bank confirms. They asked if we can provide an email address for wire remittance upload and whom to copy for expedited reconciliation.

Sam O'Leary: Use finance-wires@redwood.com and cc billing-ops. Once we receive trace, ops will verify against bank feed and update invoice state. If match found, we'll settle and release holds. If mismatch, hold remains and we escalate.

wire-bot: Wire instruction doc link: https://internal.redwood.com/finance/wires (restricted).

Javier Morales: I'll send the wire template to the customer from finance-wires@redwood.com and pause autopay completely. Also will create a journal entry for pending wire and a reconciliation ticket.

Lina Tran: Recap: CS (Priya) collect SWIFT/trace and upload to finance-wires@redwood.com; Finance (Javier) pause autopay, create pending-wire entry, may authorize up to $10k safety credit if services risk interruption; billing-bot flagged INV-2401 hold=awaiting_wire. Keep this thread until payment clears. :white_check_mark:

Priya Nair: Uploaded customer's remittance PDF to finance-wires@ and CRM. Bank trace received: SWIFT MT103 with reference INV-2401. Customer says funds outbound at 09:12am GMT. I'll post when reconciliation confirms.

Javier Morales: Received remittance. Will watch bank feed and reconcile. If settled, I'll mark paid and remove hold.

billing-bot: INV-2401 status updated: pending_wire. Autopay remains paused.

Lina Tran: Thanks team. Please keep updates concise here.
